recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, low-poly vector portrait of a male figure wearing sunglasses and a backward cap, set against a stark white background with arched serif typography above and secondary sans-serif text below.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched title framing the top of the central head illustration
High-contrast black accessories against warm-toned faceted skin
Geometric facet shading defining facial structure and depth
Strict vertical alignment of all elements on a white field
coreInvariants: Sunglasses as a primary facial feature

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, reflective sunglasses at the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the arched title, moves down through the sunglasses to the mouth, and ends at the bottom metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central cluster, emphasizing the vector art.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and terracottas used for the faceted skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the hat, hair, sunglasses, and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold for the sunglasses hardware and teeth detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white background and black elements; medium saturation in the skin facets.

letterConstructionRules: Top text follows a precise circular arch path
Bottom text is strictly horizontal and condensed
High stroke contrast in the serif display face
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyph forms used within a specific layout path
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a functional condensed sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory badge in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serifs and sharp terminals of the display text.
Matches the condensed, uniform stroke weight of the bottom metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a low-poly vector illustration of a man's head facing slightly right. He wears a black backward baseball cap and large black sunglasses with gold accents. The skin should be rendered in distinct geometric facets of brown and terracotta. The background is solid white. Leave the top and bottom areas clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold high-contrast serif font, arched over the head. Add the secondary metadata at the bottom center in a condensed sans-serif font. Place a standard parental advisory badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the skin rendered in distinct geometric polygons?
Is the top text arched correctly?

adjustableVariables: Facet density of the low-poly art
Arc radius of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Unique brand logos on the sunglasses
Specific wording of the title and metadata
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no photographic textures are present.
Check that the arch of the text is symmetrical.
Verify the low-poly facets don't look like accidental noise.
Confirm the white background is completely flat and empty.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vector Low-Poly Portrait + Arched Serif Display + Condensed Sans-Serif Metadata + Minimalist White Field
